headline: Mentoring and office hours
body: I mentor the way I build: start from something that runs, add one constraint at a time, and end every session with a written next step. Use the booking link for a first conversation, or skim session types below if you are routing this for a team.
audience: Software engineers growing into senior work, tech leads who want sharper review habits, and game-program students who need honest feedback on a vertical slice.
durationSummary: About 45 minutes for a 1:1 intro or career-focused chat; about 90 minutes for a small-group clinic (debugging, portfolio review, or interview prep).

testimonials.quote: Office hours ended with a checklist I actually used the same week. No vague cheerleading.
testimonials.name: Engineering mentee

testimonials.quote: The group session turned our broken build into a teachable moment for the whole lab.
testimonials.name: Teaching assistant
